summary.en: Spotify & local music player for Windows and macOS with bilingual word-timed lyrics, multi-monitor island, Flow backdrop, and Liquid Glass.
summary.zh-CN: 支持双语逐字歌词、跨屏灵动岛、流光背景、液态玻璃与本地音乐的 Windows / macOS Spotify 播放器。

description.en: An independent fork of MySpotify for Windows and macOS built with MyGo's native UI. Adds an embedded multi-source bilingual lyrics engine (NetEase, QQ Music, LRCLIB via Lyricify Lyrics Helper), a draggable multi-monitor Dynamic Island with instant click-through unlock, word-timed bilingual stage animations, Apple Music-style GPU Flow backdrop, iOS-style Liquid Glass controls, local music playback, and sticky playlist search.
description.zh-CN: 基于 MyGo 原生界面开发的 MySpotify 独立定制分支，支持 Windows 与 macOS。内置多源双语歌词检索（网易云、QQ 音乐、LRCLIB），提供可自由拖动跨屏的灵动岛（锁定点击穿透后点击直接浮出解锁按钮）、双语逐字弹跳律动模式、Apple Music 风格 GPU 流光背景、iOS 风格液态玻璃控件、本地音乐播放与歌单简繁吸顶搜索。
